subject: Coordinating multi-stakeholder demo + contract redline session
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@aethersys.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@aethersys.com, security@aethersys.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: combined demo + contract redline session

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team found the throughput numbers promising. Procurement and security want to combine two things into one meeting to speed this along: a short product demo (30m), then a focused contract redline session (30-45m) with our legal/procurement leads. We also want one of our engineers to be on the call for technical questions.

High-level ask: can Redwood run a 75-minute "demo + redline" calendar slot next week that includes AE, SE, legal, procurement and our security/engineer stakeholders? Preferably during PDT mornings.

Availability (our side):
- Tue 2026-08-11: 09:00-12:00 PDT
- Wed 2026-08-12: 10:00-12:00 PDT
- Thu 2026-08-13: 08:00-11:00 PDT

I've attached our RFP questions and the procurement contact is procurement@aethersys.com.

Please loop in the right folks at Redwood so we can get a calendar invite out.

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
Senior Procurement Manager | Aether Systems
[Attachment: Aether_RFP_Questions.pdf (pdf)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@aethersys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@aethersys.com, security@aethersys.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: combined demo + contract redline session

Hi Maria — thanks for consolidating. Happy to run a combined slot; I think that's the fastest path.

Marissa (SE) will lead the demo and walk through the performance and deployment model. Karthik (legal) will attend the redline portion to triage scope/SLA questions, and Lauren (my manager) will be available if we need to escalate commercial terms.

From Redwood's side, proposed blocks (PDT):
- Wed 2026-08-12: 10:30-11:45 (best)
- Wed 2026-08-12: 11:00-12:15
- Thu 2026-08-13: 09:00-10:15

If any of those work I can send a combined calendar invite with separate agenda segments (30m demo / 45m redline). Also, could you share the latest draft contract (or the clause IDs you want to focus on)? We'll bring a preliminary SOW draft to speed discussion.

I'll put tentative hold on the 10:30 slot and attach an agenda + SOW stub.

—
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: Redwood_Draft_SOW_v1.docx (docx)]
[Related: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/DEAL-2026-1119]

From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@aethersys.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@aethersys.com>
Cc: security@aethersys.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: combined demo + contract redline session

Diego / Maria — Evan from Aether infra team here. 10:30 PDT on Wed works for me. Two asks for the call:
1) Can SE bring a slide on KV cache behavior for multi-tenant routing? We want to understand cold-starts for our worst-case latencies.
2) If you can pre-share the SOW clauses you expect to change, our legal team will be faster.

I'll be on the call and can loop in our security lead if needed.

Thanks,
Evan Liu
Staff Engineer, Platform | Aether Systems

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@aethersys.com>, Evan Liu <evan.liu@aethersys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@aethersys.com, security@aethersys.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Wed 10:30 PDT confirmed — calendar invite + agenda

Confirmed: Wed 2026-08-12 10:30-11:45 PDT (75m). Calendar invite attached. Agenda below:

- 10:30-11:00 — Technical demo (Marissa Cole)
  - KV cache behavior, batching/latency tradeoffs, deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated)
  - Q&A with Evan
- 11:00-11:45 — Contract redline (Karthik Iyer + Diego)
  - Focus on data handling, SLAs, liability caps, termination, and onboarding SOW items
  - Quick commercial readout (Lauren) if we need to triage pricing/credits

Attachments: Redwood_Draft_SOW_v1.docx, calendar-bridge-invite.ics

Notes/asks for Aether: please flag the top 3 clauses you want to redline in advance (security, data residency, indemnity are common ones). If you share clause numbers we can mark them in the doc and enter the meeting with proposed language.

I'll send a brief prep doc to participants an hour before the call.

Diego
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks — I'll prepare a 28-minute deck with one 2-minute buffer for transitions. Planning to include:
- Quick latency/cost graphs from similar deployments
- Runbook sketch for incident isolation (two slides)
- Short demo flow showing deployment toggle (hosted -> dedicated)

Also looping Karthik to confirm whether we should have editable redline comments live in the Doc during the call or only the meeting transcription for legal record. My preference is live comments so we can resolve fast; Karthik, any preference?
